column1: # Each test's seconds and processor seconds in a self-coverage run on Linux,
# from the test-seconds.tsv each slice keeps with its run (run 40516094373,
# 2026-10-27); a name in two binaries is their sum. The slices are dealt by
# the larger of the two. Refresh:
#   cat run-*/test-seconds.tsv | awk -F'\t' '{ w[$1] += $2; c[$1] += $3 } END { for (n in w) printf "%s\t%.1f\t%.1f\n", n, w[n], c[n] }' | LC_ALL=C sort
# Tests added since are estimated from a local run until the next refresh.
